description: bits-ui's Checkbox and Label compiled from their published source through shadcn-svelte's unmodified checkbox, label and field wrappers and the checkbox and label demos (the check icon through this repository's IconPlaceholder stand-in, the lucide icon the shadcn-svelte CLI installs in its place), and a checkbox bound to the app (bind:checked, bind:indeterminate, onCheckedChange). Toggled by clicks on the boxes, by clicks on their labels (the label's click activates the labelled button), by double clicks on a label (bits-ui's Label cancels the second mousedown: e.detail > 1), by Space on the focused box (Enter is cancelled and does nothing outside forms), from outside through the bound values; the disabled box ignores clicks. aria-checked true/false/mixed, data-state checked/unchecked/indeterminate, the hidden input's checked property (svelte-toolbelt's srOnlyStyles), and the label's and Field's classes
